summary: One client asks for LTP, then Quote too, on the same equity: the LTP frame from the tk snapshot, the touchline subscribed again for Quote and its new tk serving a Quote and an LTP frame, then Quote alone from a delta once LTP is let go.

notes: The desktop moves the instrument from LTP to Quote by unsubscribing and subscribing the touchline again (the default BrokerFeed::mode_change_frames); the web sends a second t subscribe and keeps both modes on one entry (all_modes). AliceBlue answers a t subscribe with a fresh tk snapshot, which this case pushes.
The desktop starts the instrument's snapshot afresh on that mode change (audit appendix item 13); a delta arriving before the new tk would carry zeros for the fields it lacks.

deviations.reason: The web sends AliceBlue's feed time ft as ltt in epoch seconds, an integer since web #2473 (aliceblue_adapter.py `_feed_time`, `_quote_fields`); the docs key ltt is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md).
